'''Unit One''' was a squad of five corporate security officers working for [[TransGalMeg Industries, Incorporated]]'s [[TransGalMeg Industries Security Division|Security Division]]. They were stationed at the [[TransGalMeg Industries, Incorporated Administration Center]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Narg]], and were under the overall command of [[Jonnas Perrsta]].<ref name="The Abduction">''[[The Abduction]]''</ref>
